checks.question: Revise the supplied eight-spoke cover. Keep its outside diameter 70 mm, inner rim diameter 58 mm, central hub diameter 18 mm, thickness 6 mm and pose. Narrow every spoke from 5.0 to 3.5 mm, symmetrically about its existing radial centreline. Retain all eight spokes, their 45-degree spacing and their continuous connection into the hub and rim. Increase the central through-bore from diameter 8 to 10 mm. Add four diameter-3.2 mm through-holes at the four cardinal directions on a diameter-64 mm pitch circle. From the top face, counterbore each new hole to diameter 5.0 mm and depth 1.5 mm. Keep the original flat top and bottom outside those cuts. Do not shift the spokes to make room, merge the eight open sectors, break the narrow rim walls, or retain material where a spoke was narrowed.；按本题允许修改范围检查形态或照明变化，N中已计的尺寸/数量不在此重复计分。
